title: Volume rebate for a customer
body:
Account managers want to see the volume rebate a customer has earned.

Add `rebate_for(customer_id)` to `parcelo/customers.py`. The rebate is a share of what the customer has paid us: 3% of the total of their paid invoices once they have 10 or more shipments, and 6% once they have 50 or more. With fewer than 10 shipments the rebate is zero. `volume_tier` in `parcelo/legacy/billing.py` already uses the same shipment-count cut-offs.

Asking for a customer that does not exist must fail.
